questions.question: How many applications did we receive this financial year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases WHERE received_at >= DATE '2026-04-01'

questions.question: What was our turnaround in the first quarter of this financial year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-07-01'

questions.question: How many documents did we review last week?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-19' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-10-26'

questions.question: What share of applications decided in October 2026 were first-time right?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.status = 'approved' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caseflow.documents d WHERE d.case_id = c.case_id AND d.outcome = 'ask_applicant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS first_time_right_pct FROM caseflow.cases c WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: What share of applications decided in October 2026 were within our 3-day promise?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN working_days_open - applicant_wait_days <= 3 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS within_promise_pct FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: Which analyst in my region had the highest first-time-right rate in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.analyst_name FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.analysts a ON a.analyst_id = c.analyst_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY a.analyst_name ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN c.status = 'approved' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caseflow.documents d WHERE d.case_id = c.case_id AND d.outcome = 'ask_applicant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) DESC, a.analyst_name LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many applications are overdue right now?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'escalated') AND working_days_open - applicant_wait_days > 3

questions.question: How many of my team's applications are overdue right now?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('open', 'escalated') AND working_days_open - applicant_wait_days > 3

questions.question: How many applications that were asked for something else were then approved, in Q3 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND c.status = 'approved' AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-10-01'

questions.question: In my region, how many applications received in 2026 had more than one document asked again?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM (SELECT d.case_id FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND c.received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.case_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

questions.question: What is the average number of documents per application, by customer type, for applications received in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type, ROUND(COUNT(d.document_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id), 1) AS documents_per_application FROM caseflow.cases c LEFT JOIN caseflow.documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id WHERE c.received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_type

questions.question: In which week of September 2026 did we review the most documents? Give the Monday's date.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', reviewed_at) AS DATE) AS week_starting FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the backlog in my region per analyst?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM caseflow.analysts), 1) AS documents_per_analyst FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'open'

questions.question: How many working days were there in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS working_days FROM caseflow.calendar WHERE month = '2026-10' AND is_working_day

questions.question: What was the turnaround for each channel this financial year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT channel, MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY channel

questions.question: How many documents did my team review per working day last week?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM caseflow.calendar WHERE is_working_day AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-19' AND DATE '2026-10-25'), 1) AS per_working_day FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-19' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-10-26'

questions.question: How many applications were withdrawn this financial year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawn FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status = 'withdrawn' AND closed_at >= DATE '2026-04-01'

questions.question: What does one application cost us in analyst pay?
How many applications in each of my teams were decided within the promise in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS within_promise FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.working_days_open - c.applicant_wait_days <= 3 AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name

questions.question: How many applications received in FY2025/26 Q4 were withdrawn?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawn FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.calendar k ON k.day = CAST(c.received_at AS DATE) WHERE k.financial_quarter = 'FY2025/26 Q4' AND c.status = 'withdrawn'
